title: Guidewire experiment journal
scope: Permitted aggregate summaries recorded in project notes. This is a curated historical log, not a copy of private artifacts. Saved reports are linked at runtime on Perlmutter and kept distinct from these owner-reported snapshots.
takeaway: All four development models show overfitting in the recorded curve reviews. Static latest+goal+movement metadata matches the early-goal GRU closely on selected validation BA; these runs do not demonstrate a benefit from visual-history processing. One seed and 80 related validation cases do not establish superiority or uselessness of history.

trials.title: GRU baseline · Adam
trials.question: Does frozen visual history + goal + movement metadata generalize?
trials.change: Six visual frames through a 64-unit GRU; goal enters the classifier; Adam without weight decay.
trials.observation: Selected validation BA 59.21%, versus training BA 87.20%. Training improves while validation loss rises; the selected peak was isolated in supplied points.
trials.decision: Retain as the original reference; test regularization with the same inputs before widening the model.
trials.provenance: Pre-run revision confirmed; aggregate metrics rounded as supplied. Private baseline directory has not been confirmed; match by saved settings, selected/final epochs and score, not its name.

trials.title: GRU · AdamW regularization
trials.question: Does weight decay reduce the generalization gap and improve validation BA?
trials.change: Same late-goal architecture; switch to AdamW with weight decay 0.01.
trials.observation: Selected BA 57.48%, below the Adam baseline. The selected epoch favors ADVANCE; train/validation divergence continues.
trials.decision: Do not replace the baseline based on ordinary accuracy or a smaller gap alone; keep this completed comparison.
trials.provenance: Saved revision and AdamW settings reported. Saved dirty flag true; exact tracked/untracked source details unverified.

trials.title: GRU · goal at every step
trials.question: Does access to the goal during memory updates help?
trials.change: Repeat goal384 at each GRU step; retain direct goal fusion; return to Adam/zero decay. Parameters increase to 189,378.
trials.observation: Selected BA 60.87%; curve still overfits. The larger head changes capacity as well as goal timing.
trials.decision: Keep for comparison; current evidence does not justify widening it or claiming route understanding.
trials.provenance: Published code and intended invocation recorded; saved run revision/configuration/dirty state and selected/final numeric training scores remain uninspected.

trials.title: Static · latest image + goal + movement history
trials.question: Does processing six visual frames add value beyond the latest image and movement metadata?
trials.change: No GRU: latest384 + goal384 + six depth/time pairs → 780→64→2. Adam/zero decay; 50,114 parameters.
trials.observation: Selected BA 61.13%, close to early-goal GRU 60.87%. RETRACT recall falls to 35.29% while ADVANCE reaches 86.96%. Screenshot still shows overfitting.
trials.decision: No demonstrated visual-history advantage in these runs. Preserve both model families; inspect representation and saved aggregates before another experiment.
trials.provenance: Compute-node HEAD aa1496a and CUDA confirmed before execution. Summary supplied, freeze/reload passed. Saved context/dirty state not yet inspected; screenshot readings are qualitative.

other_work.title: Reader, preparation and frozen-encoder readiness
other_work.question: Are image/goal roles and metadata aligned, and can frozen DINOv2 extraction run?
other_work.outcome: Synthetic loader/preparation/encoder checks and owner-run real-case CPU extraction/grouping passed. This is infrastructure evidence, not classifier validation.

other_work.title: Marker/wire feature-sensitivity checks
other_work.question: Do the whole-image summaries visibly respond to target and wire changes?
other_work.outcome: A one-frame masking result is recorded as inconclusive for temporal usefulness. Do not turn sensitivity into a claim of learned route reasoning or repeat masking merely to resume.

other_work.title: Eight-case GRU learning check
other_work.question: Can the frozen-feature head actually update and fit a tiny training subset?
other_work.outcome: 300 updates: training loss 0.775900 → 0.000129; accuracy 50% → 100%. Finite gradients, changed head and unchanged encoder reported. Training-only memorization; no held-out score or checkpoint.

probe_baseline.title: Sabrina's frozen-feature probe comparison
probe_baseline.note: Owner-reported split-0 validation results rounded to three decimals. Centered per-column scaling, class-balanced L2 logistic fitting and validation-selected C differ from the PyTorch recipe. Goal-only result is not proof of leakage. Full report access may be unavailable from another account; do not copy private artifacts between accounts.
